retainedText: atles’ songs – complete A-Z list » Love You To Love You To - Home - The Beatles’ songs – complete A-Z list - Love You To [Revolver album artwork]Written by: Harrison Recorded: 11, 13 April 1966 Producer: George Martin Engineer: Geoff Emerick Released: 5 August 1966 (UK), 8 August 1966 (US) Available on: Revolver Yellow Submarine Songtrack Personnel George Harrison: vocals, acoustic guitar, electric guitar, sitar Paul McCartney: backing vocals, tambura Ringo Starr: tambourine Anil Bhagwat: tabla Following the sitar motif on ‘Norwegian Wood (This Bird Has Flown)’, ‘Love You To’ was The Beatles’ first full attempt at recording a piece of music in the classical Indian style. At the time George Harrison was learning the sitar from Ravi Shankar, who inspired him to learn more about Indian music and Eastern religion. I wrote ‘Love You To’ on the sitar, because the sitar sounded so nice and my interest was getting deeper all the time. I wanted to write a tune that was specifically for the sitar.
